title: Create Your Own Work Stack: Deploying Self-hosted AI and Tooling in a Tech Startup
abstract: arXiv:2611.08116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-hosting AI is often presented as a way to reduce inference costs and increase control, but deployment introduces its own costs. We report our experience deploying a hybrid AI stack at Grayhat Developers, a small software company with an AI-intensive development workflow. Our initial motivation was to counter the growing cost of commercial AI usage: Claude/Codex incurred approximately \$325 per month, with more than 25.93 billion recorded tokens. tldr: 该论文分享了一家小型软件公司部署混合 AI 栈的实践经验——商业 AI 代理负责复杂任务，本地开源模型承担低复杂度任务、组织信息检索及自托管工具同步，从而在不牺牲质量的前提下削减约 30–40% 的商业 AI 使用成本。
